[Anwar et al. 2026 (information theory)](./#p=anwar2026analyzing) bound the accuracy uplift of the Bayes-optimal CoT monitor over the Bayes-optimal prompt-only monitor through the conditional mutual information, $0\le\delta\le\sqrt{2I(Y;Z\mid X)}$. They also define a monitor-class version, $I_{\mathcal{V}}(Y;Z\mid X)$, which counts only the information that monitors in a class $\mathcal V$ can use (usable information).
